sources.title: This year's Founders' Letter
sources.quote_checked: We will move from mobile first to an AI first world. | we see it as our job to make it available to as many people as possible. | Google Search works the same for anyone with an Internet connection, whether it is in a modern high-rise or a rural schoolhouse.

sources.title: AI at Google: our principles
sources.quote_checked: As a leader in AI, we feel a deep responsibility to get this right.

sources.title: A letter from Larry and Sergey
sources.quote_checked: Sundar brings humility and a deep passion for technology to our users, partners and our employees every day.

sources.title: G is for Google
sources.quote_checked: it is clear to us and our board that it is time for Sundar to be CEO of Google.

sources.title: Update from the CEO
sources.quote_checked: Sundar has a talent for creating products that are technically excellent yet easy to use—and he loves a big bet. | In 2008, people asked whether the world really needed another browser.

sources.title: Sundar Pichai: CEO of Google and Alphabet
sources.quote_checked: the browser was never meant for that world | it's the most fun I've had building a product from the ground up | the main bet I made as a CEO was to really make sure the company was approaching everything in a AI-first way | doesn't matter | I'm good at tuning out noise, separating signal from noise. | I think it's important, when you can, to hear everyone out. | it's time to disagree and commit so that we can get moving. | we always prioritized being ambitious and safety at the same time
